macro chmax(target, other)
  {{target}} = ({{other}}) if ({{target}}) < ({{other}})
end

class Problem
  getter n : Int32
  getter m : Int32
  getter g : Array(Array(Int32))
  getter rg : Array(Array(Int32)) # 逆順グラフ

  def initialize
    @n, @m = gets.to_s.split.map { |v| v.to_i }
    @g = Array.new(n) { [] of Int32 }
    @rg = Array.new(n) { [] of Int32 }
    m.times do
      s, t = gets.to_s.split.map { |v| v.to_i - 1 }
      g[s] << t
      rg[t] << s
    end
  end

  # 各ノードに到達する確率
  def probability
    dp = Array.new(n, 0_f64)
    dp[0] = 1
    n.times do |v|
      g[v].each do |nv|
        dp[nv] += dp[v] / g[v].size
      end
    end
    dp
  end
  
  # ゴールまでの残移動距離の期待値
  def expected_value
    dp = Array.new(n, 0_f64) # 確率
    (n-1).downto(0) do |v|
      rg[v].each do |nv|
        dp[nv] += (dp[v] + 1) / g[nv].size
      end
    end
    dp
  end

  # 辺消去後の期待値  
  def after(ev,env,odeg)
    ev - (ev * odeg - (env + 1)) / (odeg - 1)
  end
  
  def solve
    p = probability
    e = expected_value
    ans = 0_f64
    n.times do |v|
      g[v].each do |nv|
        odeg = g[v].size
        next if odeg == 1
        chmax ans, after(e[v], e[nv], odeg) * p[v]
      end
    end
    e[0] - ans
  end

  def show(ans)
    puts ans
  end

  def instance_eval
    with self yield
  end
end

Problem.new.instance_eval do
  show(solve)
end

local mma, mmi = math.max, math.min
local n, m = io.read("*n", "*n")
local edge = {}
local inf = n + 1
for i = 1, n do
  edge[i] = {}
end
for i = 1, m do
  local a, b = io.read("*n", "*n")
  table.insert(edge[a], b)
end

local len = {}
local function solve(z)
  for i = 1, n - 1 do
    len[i] = inf
  end
  len[n] = 0
  for idx = n - 1, 1, -1 do
    if #edge[idx] == 1 then
      len[idx] = 1 + len[edge[idx][1]]
    else
      local lensum, lenmax = 0, 0
      for i = 1, #edge[idx] do
        local v = len[edge[idx][i]]
        lensum = lensum + v
        lenmax = mma(lenmax, v)
      end
      if z == idx then
        len[idx] = 1 + (lensum - lenmax) / (#edge[idx] - 1)
      else
        len[idx] = 1 + lensum / #edge[idx]
      end
    end
  end
  return len[1]
end
local ret = solve(1)
for i = 2, n do
  ret = mmi(ret, solve(i))
end
print(string.format("%.9f", ret))

query :: Int -> GraphData () -> Double
query n gd = runST $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  forM_ [n-2,n-3..1] $ \ !i -> do
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
    !res <- (1+) . (/ toDouble (VU.length outi))
      <$> VU.foldM' (\ !v !j -> (v+) <$> VUM.read dp j) 0 (VU.map fst outi)
    VUM.write dp i res
  VU.foldM'
    (\ !acc !i -> min acc <$> do
        let outi = edgesOut gd i
            len = VU.length outi
        !resi <-
          if len <= 1 then
            fmap (1+) $ VUM.read dp $ fst $ VU.head outi
          else
            (\(!maxl,!tot) -> 1 + (tot-maxl)/toDouble (len-1))
            <$> VU.foldM' (\(!maxl,!tot) (j,()) -> do
                              dpj <- VUM.read dp j
                              let !maxl1 = max maxl dpj
                                  !tot1 = tot + dpj
                              return (maxl1,tot1))
                          (0,0) outi
        VUM.write dp i resi
        forM_ [i-1,i-2..0] $ \ !i -> do
          let outi = edgesOut gd i
          !res <- (1+) . (/ toDouble (VU.length outi))
            <$> VU.foldM' (\ !v !j -> (v+) <$> VUM.read dp j) 0
                  (VU.map fst outi)
          VUM.write dp i res
        VUM.read dp 0)
    (1/0)
    (VU.generate (n-1) id)

type Vertex = Int
data GraphData d = GraphData {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector (Vertex,d))
                             {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Int)
data MGraphData s d = MGraphData {-# UNPACK #-} !(VUM.MVector s (Vertex,d))
                                 {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Int)
data TreeData d = TreeData {-# UNPACK #-} !Vertex
                           {-# UNPACK #-} !(GraphData d)

edgesOut :: (VU.Unbox d)
  => GraphData d -> Vertex -> VU.Vector (Vertex,d)
edgesOut (GraphData connTable degCount) vert
  = VU.slice beg (end-beg) connTable
  where
    !end = degCount VU.! (vert+1)
    !beg = degCount VU.! vert

type Depth = Int
{-# INLINE getTreeWithDepths #-}
getTreeWithDepths :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Vertex -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (TreeData d,VU.Vector Depth)
getTreeWithDepths !numVert !root getEdge = do
  !gd <- getUndirectedGraphMut numVert (numVert-1) getEdge
  !depths <- dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph gd root
  !gdFrozen <- unsafeFreezeGraphData gd
  return (TreeData root gdFrozen, depths)

dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> Vertex -> m (VU.Vector Depth)
dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph (MGraphData connTable degCount) !root = do
  depths <- VUM.replicate (VU.length degCount - 1) (-1)
  let dfs !parent !this !depth = do
        !prevDepth <- VUM.read depths this
        when (prevDepth < 0) $ do
          VUM.unsafeWrite depths this depth
          let !beg = VU.unsafeIndex degCount this
              !end = VU.unsafeIndex degCount (this+1) - 1
          forM_ [beg..end] $ \ !i -> do
            (!vertex,!d) <- VUM.read connTable i
            if vertex == parent
              then do !vbeg <- VUM.unsafeRead connTable beg
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable beg (vertex,d)
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable i vbeg
              else dfs this vertex (depth+1)
  dfs (-1) root 0
  VU.unsafeFreeze depths

{-# INLINE unsafeFreezeGraphData #-}
unsafeFreezeGraphData :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> m (GraphData d)
unsafeFreezeGraphData (MGraphData connTable degCount)
  = (`GraphData` degCount) <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze connTable 


{-# INLINE getDirectedGraphForward #-}
getDirectedGraphForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> m (Int,Int,d) -> m (GraphData d)
getDirectedGraphForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  getDirectedGraphMutForward numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData


{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraph #-}
getUndirectedGraph
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (GraphData d)
getUndirectedGraph !numVert !numEdges getEdge
  = getUndirectedGraphMut numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData

{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraphMut #-}
getUndirectedGraphMut
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getUndirectedGraphMut !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new (shiftL numEdges 1)
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (b+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)
        !ib <- VUM.read degCount (b+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (b+1) $! ib+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ib $! (a,d)
      
getDirectedGraphMutForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d))
  -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getDirectedGraphMutForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new numEdges
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)

  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

{-# INLINE v2BSpcSepWith #-}

{-# INLINE v2BConcatWith #-}

  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty

  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

{-# INLINE vecToBuilder #-}
vecToBuilder :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


{-# INLINE vecToBuilder_ #-}
vecToBuilder_ :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct vec
  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

ave :: [Double] -> Maybe Double
ave [] = Nothing
ave x = Just $ (sum x) / (fromIntegral $ length x)

f :: [Int] -> [[Int]] -> Maybe [(Int,Double)]
f [] a = Just [(0,-1)]
f (x:xs) a = do 
    ys <- f xs a
    z <- ave $ map (\z -> snd $ fromJust $ find (\(n,e) -> n == (last z)) ys) $ filter (\z -> (head z) == x) a
    return $ (x,z+1):ys
    -- return $ (x,((ave $ map (\z -> snd $ fromJust $ find (\(n,e) -> n == (last z)) ys) $ filter (\z -> (head z) == x) a) + 1):ys)

g :: [a] -> [[a]]
g (x:xs) = xs:(map (\y -> x:y) (g xs))
g [] = []

data Folder = F {-# UNPACK #-} !Double {-# UNPACK #-} !Double

instance Semigroup Folder where
  F m0 t0 <> F m1 t1 = F (max m0 m1) (t0 + t1)

instance Monoid Folder where
  mappend = (<>)
  mempty = F (-1/0) 0
  mconcat = foldl' (<>) mempty

query :: Int -> GraphData () -> Double
query n gd
  = VU.minimum
    $ (\f -> VU.izipWith f means probs)
    $ \ !i !meani !probi ->
        let outi = edgesOut gd i
            !lenOut = VU.length outi
            meanRmv = (\(F m t) -> 1 + (t-m) / toDouble (lenOut-1))
                        $ VU.foldl' (\x y -> x <> F y y) mempty
                        $ VU.backpermute means $ VU.map fst outi
        in if lenOut <= 1
           then plainRes
           else plainRes - probi * (meani - meanRmv)
  where
    !plainRes = VU.head means
    means = meanJumps n gd
    probs = arrvProbs n gd

meanJumps :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
meanJumps !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  forM_ [n-2,n-3..0] $ \ !i -> do
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
    !sumDP <- VU.foldM' (\ !v (!j,()) -> (v+) <$> VUM.read dp j) 0 outi
    VUM.unsafeWrite dp i $! 1 + sumDP / toDouble (VU.length outi)
  return dp

arrvProbs :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
arrvProbs !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  VUM.write dp 0 1
  forM_ [0..n-2] $ \ !i -> do
    p_i <- VUM.unsafeRead dp i
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
        !distProb = p_i / toDouble (VU.length outi)
    VU.forM_ outi $ VUM.modify dp (+distProb) . fst
  return dp
    

type Vertex = Int
data GraphData d = GraphData {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector (Vertex,d))
                             {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Int)
data MGraphData s d = MGraphData {-# UNPACK #-} !(VUM.MVector s (Vertex,d))
                                 {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector Int)
data TreeData d = TreeData {-# UNPACK #-} !Vertex
                           {-# UNPACK #-} !(GraphData d)

edgesOut :: (VU.Unbox d)
  => GraphData d -> Vertex -> VU.Vector (Vertex,d)
edgesOut (GraphData connTable degCount) vert
  = VU.slice beg (end-beg) connTable
  where
    !end = degCount VU.! (vert+1)
    !beg = degCount VU.! vert

type Depth = Int
{-# INLINE getTreeWithDepths #-}
getTreeWithDepths :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Vertex -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (TreeData d,VU.Vector Depth)
getTreeWithDepths !numVert !root getEdge = do
  !gd <- getUndirectedGraphMut numVert (numVert-1) getEdge
  !depths <- dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph gd root
  !gdFrozen <- unsafeFreezeGraphData gd
  return (TreeData root gdFrozen, depths)

dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> Vertex -> m (VU.Vector Depth)
dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph (MGraphData connTable degCount) !root = do
  depths <- VUM.replicate (VU.length degCount - 1) (-1)
  let dfs !parent !this !depth = do
        !prevDepth <- VUM.read depths this
        when (prevDepth < 0) $ do
          VUM.unsafeWrite depths this depth
          let !beg = VU.unsafeIndex degCount this
              !end = VU.unsafeIndex degCount (this+1) - 1
          forM_ [beg..end] $ \ !i -> do
            (!vertex,!d) <- VUM.read connTable i
            if vertex == parent
              then do !vbeg <- VUM.unsafeRead connTable beg
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable beg (vertex,d)
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable i vbeg
              else dfs this vertex (depth+1)
  dfs (-1) root 0
  VU.unsafeFreeze depths

{-# INLINE unsafeFreezeGraphData #-}
unsafeFreezeGraphData :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> m (GraphData d)
unsafeFreezeGraphData (MGraphData connTable degCount)
  = (`GraphData` degCount) <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze connTable 


{-# INLINE getDirectedGraphForward #-}
getDirectedGraphForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> m (Int,Int,d) -> m (GraphData d)
getDirectedGraphForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  getDirectedGraphMutForward numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData


{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraph #-}
getUndirectedGraph
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (GraphData d)
getUndirectedGraph !numVert !numEdges getEdge
  = getUndirectedGraphMut numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData

{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraphMut #-}
getUndirectedGraphMut
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getUndirectedGraphMut !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new (shiftL numEdges 1)
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (b+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)
        !ib <- VUM.read degCount (b+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (b+1) $! ib+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ib $! (a,d)
      
getDirectedGraphMutForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d))
  -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getDirectedGraphMutForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new numEdges
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)

v2BSpcSepLnWith, v2BSpcSepWith, v2BConcatWith, v2BLinesWith ::
  (VG.Vector v a)
  => (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
{-# INLINE v2BSpcSepLnWith #-}
v2BSpcSepLnWith = v2BSpcSepPostfWith "\n"
{-# INLINE v2BSpcSepWith #-}
v2BSpcSepWith = v2BSpcSepPostfWith ""
{-# INLINE v2BConcatWith #-}
v2BConcatWith showFct = VG.foldr ((<>) . showFct) mempty
{-# INLINE v2BLinesWith #-}
v2BLinesWith showFct
  = VG.foldr (\ a -> (showFct a <>) . (BSB.char7 '\n' <>)) mempty


v2BSpcSepPostf :: (VG.Vector v a, ShowAsBuilder a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
{-# INLINE v2BSpcSepPostf #-}
v2BSpcSepPostf = (`v2BSpcSepPostfWith` showAsBuilder)

v2BSpcSepPostfWith :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
{-# INLINE v2BSpcSepPostfWith #-}
v2BSpcSepPostfWith = vecToBuilder "" " "

{-# INLINE vecToBuilder #-}
vecToBuilder :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


{-# INLINE vecToBuilder_ #-}
vecToBuilder_ :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct vec
  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

IL(wrA) = A.writeArray
IL(rdA) = A.readArray
IL(mdA) = \arr f !i -> do
  ai <- rdA arr i
  let fai = f ai 
  wrA arr i fai
  return (ai,fai)
{-# INLINE mdA' #-}
mdA' = \arr f !i -> do
  !ai <- rdA arr i
  let !fai = f ai
  wrA arr i fai
  return (ai,fai)
IL(swapA) = \arr !i !j -> do
  ai <- rdA arr i
  wrA arr i =<< rdA arr j
  wrA arr j ai

query :: Int -> GraphData () -> Double
query n gd
  = VU.minimum
    $ (\f -> VU.izipWith f means probs)
    $ \ !i !meani !probi ->
        let outi = edgesOut gd i
            !lenOut = VU.length outi
            meanRmv = (\(F m t) -> 1 + (t-m) / toDouble (lenOut-1))
                        $ VU.foldl' (\x y -> x `mappend` F y y) mempty
                        $ VU.backpermute means $ VU.map fst outi
        in if lenOut <= 1
           then plainRes
           else plainRes - probi * (meani - meanRmv)
  where
    !plainRes = VU.head means
    means = meanJumps n gd
    probs = arrvProbs n gd

meanJumps :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
meanJumps !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  forM_ [n-2,n-3..0] $ \ !i -> do
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
    !sumDP <- VU.foldM' (\ !v (!j,()) -> (v+) <$> VUM.read dp j) 0 outi
    VUM.unsafeWrite dp i $! 1 + sumDP / toDouble (VU.length outi)
  return dp

arrvProbs :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
arrvProbs !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  VUM.write dp 0 1
  forM_ [0..n-2] $ \ !i -> do
    p_i <- VUM.unsafeRead dp i
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
        !distProb = p_i / toDouble (VU.length outi)
    VU.forM_ outi $ VUM.modify dp (+distProb) . fst
  return dp

                           {-# UNPACK #-} !(GraphData d)

edgesOut :: (VU.Unbox d)
  => GraphData d -> Vertex -> VU.Vector (Vertex,d)
edgesOut (GraphData connTable degCount) vert
  = VU.slice beg (end-beg) connTable
  where
    !end = degCount VU.! (vert+1)
    !beg = degCount VU.! vert

type Depth = Int
{-# INLINE getTreeWithDepths #-}
getTreeWithDepths :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Vertex -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (TreeData d,VU.Vector Depth)
getTreeWithDepths !numVert !root getEdge = do
  !gd <- getUndirectedGraphMut numVert (numVert-1) getEdge
  !depths <- dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph gd root
  !gdFrozen <- unsafeFreezeGraphData gd
  return (TreeData root gdFrozen, depths)

dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> Vertex -> m (VU.Vector Depth)
dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph (MGraphData connTable degCount) !root = do
  depths <- VUM.replicate (VU.length degCount - 1) (-1)
  let dfs !parent !this !depth = do
        !prevDepth <- VUM.read depths this
        when (prevDepth < 0) $ do
          VUM.unsafeWrite depths this depth
          let !beg = VU.unsafeIndex degCount this
              !end = VU.unsafeIndex degCount (this+1) - 1
          forM_ [beg..end] $ \ !i -> do
            (!vertex,!d) <- VUM.read connTable i
            if vertex == parent
              then do !vbeg <- VUM.unsafeRead connTable beg
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable beg (vertex,d)
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable i vbeg
              else dfs this vertex (depth+1)
  dfs (-1) root 0
  VU.unsafeFreeze depths

{-# INLINE unsafeFreezeGraphData #-}
unsafeFreezeGraphData :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> m (GraphData d)
unsafeFreezeGraphData (MGraphData connTable degCount)
  = (`GraphData` degCount) <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze connTable 


{-# INLINE getDirectedGraphForward #-}
getDirectedGraphForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> m (Int,Int,d) -> m (GraphData d)
getDirectedGraphForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  getDirectedGraphMutForward numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData


{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraph #-}
getUndirectedGraph
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (GraphData d)
getUndirectedGraph !numVert !numEdges getEdge
  = getUndirectedGraphMut numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData

{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraphMut #-}
getUndirectedGraphMut
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getUndirectedGraphMut !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new (shiftL numEdges 1)
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (b+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)
        !ib <- VUM.read degCount (b+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (b+1) $! ib+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ib $! (a,d)
      
getDirectedGraphMutForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d))
  -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getDirectedGraphMutForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new numEdges
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)

  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

updateGraph :: (Int, Int) -> M.Map Int [Int] -> M.Map Int [Int]
updateGraph (s, t) m = M.insert s (t:ts) m
	where ts = fromMaybe [] $ M.lookup s m
toGraph sts = reverse $ map (sortOn Down . snd) $ M.toList $ foldr updateGraph M.empty sts

renumber n st = n - st - 1

average :: (Fractional a) => [a] -> a
average [] = 0
average xs = sum' / fromIntegral count
	where
		(sum', count) = foldr sumCount (0, 0) xs
		sumCount x (sum', count) = (sum' + x, count + 1)

toPluggedProbability' :: [Double] -> Int -> [[Int]] -> [Double]
toPluggedProbability' probs _ [] = probs
toPluggedProbability' probs n (g:gs) = toPluggedProbability' newProbs (n - 1) gs
	where
		toProb (-1) = 0
		toProb t  = probs !! t
		newProbs = if n == 0
			then probs ++ [1 + (average $ tail $ sortOn Down (map toProb g))]
			else probs ++ [1 + average (map toProb g)]

toPluggedProbability :: [[Int]] -> Int -> Maybe [Double]
toPluggedProbability gs n = if length (gs !! n) >= 2
	then Just $ toPluggedProbability' [] n gs
	else Nothing

toProbability' :: [Double] -> [[Int]] -> [Double]
toProbability' probs [] = probs
toProbability' probs (g:gs) = toProbability' newProbs gs
	where
		toProb (-1) = 0
		toProb t  = probs !! t
		newProbs = probs ++ [1 + average (map toProb g)]

toProbability = toProbability' []

    ws = filter (\(b,c,d) -> elem b zs) ys
    l = fromIntegral $ length ws

query :: Int -> GraphData () -> Double
query n gd
  = VU.minimum
    $ (\f -> VU.izipWith f means probs)
    $ \ !i !meani !probi ->
        let outi = edgesOut gd i
            !lenOut = VU.length outi
            meanRmv = (\(F m t) -> 1 + (t-m) / toDouble (lenOut-1))
                        $ VU.foldl' (\x y -> x `mappend` F y y) mempty
                        $ VU.backpermute means $ VU.map fst outi
        in if lenOut <= 1
           then plainRes
           else plainRes - probi * (meani - meanRmv)
  where
    !plainRes = VU.head means
    means = meanJumps n gd
    probs = arrvProbs n gd

meanJumps :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
meanJumps !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  forM_ [n-2,n-3..0] $ \ !i -> do
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
    !sumDP <- VU.foldM' (\ !v (!j,()) -> (v+) <$> VUM.read dp j) 0 outi
    VUM.unsafeWrite dp i $! 1 + sumDP / toDouble (VU.length outi)
  return dp

arrvProbs :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
arrvProbs !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  VUM.write dp 0 1
  forM_ [0..n-2] $ \ !i -> do
    p_i <- VUM.unsafeRead dp i
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
        !distProb = p_i / toDouble (VU.length outi)
    VU.forM_ outi $ VUM.modify dp (+distProb) . fst
  return dp

edgesOut :: (VU.Unbox d)
  => GraphData d -> Vertex -> VU.Vector (Vertex,d)
edgesOut (GraphData connTable degCount) vert
  = VU.slice beg (end-beg) connTable
  where
    !end = degCount VU.! (vert+1)
    !beg = degCount VU.! vert

type Depth = Int
{-# INLINE getTreeWithDepths #-}
getTreeWithDepths :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Vertex -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (TreeData d,VU.Vector Depth)
getTreeWithDepths !numVert !root getEdge = do
  !gd <- getUndirectedGraphMut numVert (numVert-1) getEdge
  !depths <- dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph gd root
  !gdFrozen <- unsafeFreezeGraphData gd
  return (TreeData root gdFrozen, depths)

dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> Vertex -> m (VU.Vector Depth)
dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph (MGraphData connTable degCount) !root = do
  depths <- VUM.replicate (VU.length degCount - 1) (-1)
  let dfs !parent !this !depth = do
        !prevDepth <- VUM.read depths this
        when (prevDepth < 0) $ do
          VUM.unsafeWrite depths this depth
          let !beg = VU.unsafeIndex degCount this
              !end = VU.unsafeIndex degCount (this+1) - 1
          forM_ [beg..end] $ \ !i -> do
            (!vertex,!d) <- VUM.read connTable i
            if vertex == parent
              then do !vbeg <- VUM.unsafeRead connTable beg
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable beg (vertex,d)
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable i vbeg
              else dfs this vertex (depth+1)
  dfs (-1) root 0
  VU.unsafeFreeze depths

{-# INLINE unsafeFreezeGraphData #-}
unsafeFreezeGraphData :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> m (GraphData d)
unsafeFreezeGraphData (MGraphData connTable degCount)
  = (`GraphData` degCount) <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze connTable

getDirectedGraphForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>

getDirectedGraphForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  getDirectedGraphMutForward numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData


{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraph #-}
getUndirectedGraph
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (GraphData d)

  = getUndirectedGraphMut numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData

{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraphMut #-}
getUndirectedGraphMut
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getUndirectedGraphMut !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new (shiftL numEdges 1)
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (b+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)
        !ib <- VUM.read degCount (b+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (b+1) $! ib+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ib $! (a,d)

  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d))
  -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getDirectedGraphMutForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new numEdges
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where

          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge

        (\ !total !i -> do

            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do

    (const postfix) vec mempty

query :: Int -> GraphData () -> Double
query n gd
  = VU.minimum
    $ (\f -> VU.izipWith f means probs)
    $ \ !i !meani !probi ->
        let outi = edgesOut gd i
            !lenOut = VU.length outi
            meanRmv = (\(F m t) -> 1 + (t-m) / toDouble (lenOut-1))
                        $ VU.foldl' (\x y -> x <> F y y) mempty
                        $ VU.backpermute means $ VU.map fst outi
        in if lenOut <= 1
           then plainRes
           else plainRes - probi * (meani - meanRmv)
  where
    !plainRes = VU.head means
    means = meanJumps n gd
    probs = arrvProbs n gd

meanJumps :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
meanJumps !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  forM_ [n-2,n-3..0] $ \ !i -> do
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
    !sumDP <- VU.foldM' (\ !v (!j,()) -> (v+) <$> VUM.read dp j) 0 outi
    VUM.unsafeWrite dp i $! 1 + sumDP / toDouble (VU.length outi)
  return dp

arrvProbs :: Int -> GraphData () -> VU.Vector Double
arrvProbs !n !gd = VU.create $ do
  dp <- VUM.replicate n 0
  VUM.write dp 0 1
  forM_ [0..n-2] $ \ !i -> do
    p_i <- VUM.unsafeRead dp i
    let outi = edgesOut gd i
        !distProb = p_i / toDouble (VU.length outi)
    VU.forM_ outi $ VUM.modify dp (+distProb) . fst
  return dp
    

type Vertex = Int
data GraphData d = GraphData {-# UNPACK #-} !(VU.Vector (Vertex,d))

edgesOut :: (VU.Unbox d)
  => GraphData d -> Vertex -> VU.Vector (Vertex,d)
edgesOut (GraphData connTable degCount) vert
  = VU.slice beg (end-beg) connTable
  where
    !end = degCount VU.! (vert+1)
    !beg = degCount VU.! vert

type Depth = Int
{-# INLINE getTreeWithDepths #-}
getTreeWithDepths :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Vertex -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (TreeData d,VU.Vector Depth)
getTreeWithDepths !numVert !root getEdge = do
  !gd <- getUndirectedGraphMut numVert (numVert-1) getEdge
  !depths <- dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph gd root
  !gdFrozen <- unsafeFreezeGraphData gd
  return (TreeData root gdFrozen, depths)

dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => MGraphData (PrimState m) d -> Vertex -> m (VU.Vector Depth)
dfsFindTreeAndDepthInMGraph (MGraphData connTable degCount) !root = do
  depths <- VUM.replicate (VU.length degCount - 1) (-1)
  let dfs !parent !this !depth = do
        !prevDepth <- VUM.read depths this
        when (prevDepth < 0) $ do
          VUM.unsafeWrite depths this depth
          let !beg = VU.unsafeIndex degCount this
              !end = VU.unsafeIndex degCount (this+1) - 1
          forM_ [beg..end] $ \ !i -> do
            (!vertex,!d) <- VUM.read connTable i
            if vertex == parent
              then do !vbeg <- VUM.unsafeRead connTable beg
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable beg (vertex,d)
                      VUM.unsafeWrite connTable i vbeg
              else dfs this vertex (depth+1)
  dfs (-1) root 0
  VU.unsafeFreeze depths

unsafeFreezeGraphData (MGraphData connTable degCount)
  = (`GraphData` degCount) <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze connTable

  getDirectedGraphMutForward numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData


{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraph #-}
getUndirectedGraph
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d) =>
  Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (GraphData d)

  = getUndirectedGraphMut numVert numEdges getEdge >>= unsafeFreezeGraphData

{-# INLINE getUndirectedGraphMut #-}
getUndirectedGraphMut
  :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d)) -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getUndirectedGraphMut !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new (shiftL numEdges 1)
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge
          VUM.unsafeWrite temp i (a,b,d)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (a+1)
          VUM.modify degCount (+1) (b+1)
        VU.unsafeFreeze temp
      VU.foldM'
        (\ !total !i -> do
            !di <- VUM.unsafeRead degCount i
            VUM.unsafeWrite degCount i total
            return $! total+di)
        0 (VU.generate (numVert+1) id)
      VU.forM_ temp $ \(!a,!b,!d) -> do
        !ia <- VUM.read degCount (a+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (a+1) $! ia+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ia $! (b,d)
        !ib <- VUM.read degCount (b+1)
        VUM.unsafeWrite degCount (b+1) $! ib+1
        VUM.unsafeWrite connTable ib $! (a,d)
      
getDirectedGraphMutForward :: (PrimMonad m, VU.Unbox d)
  => Int -> Int -> (m (Int,Int,d))
  -> m (MGraphData (PrimState m) d)
getDirectedGraphMutForward !numVert !numEdges getEdge = do
  !degCount <- VUM.replicate (numVert+1) 0
  !connTable <- VUM.new numEdges
  write degCount connTable
  MGraphData connTable <$!> VU.unsafeFreeze degCount
  where
    write !degCount !connTable = do
      !temp <- do
        !temp <- VUM.new numEdges
        VU.forM_ (VU.generate numEdges id) $ \ !i -> do
          (!a,!b,!d) <- getEdge

function main()
	n,m = readline() |> split |> parseMap
	to = [Int[] for i in 1:n]
	fr = [Int[] for i in 1:n]
	d = zeros(Int,n)
	for i in 1:m
		s,t = readline() |> split |> parseMap
		push!(to[s],t)
		push!(fr[t],s)
		d[s] += 1
	end
	z = zeros(Float64,n)
	for i in 0:n-1
		for j in fr[n-i]
			z[j] += (1.0+z[n-i])/d[j]
		end
	end
	minim = z[1]
	for i in 1:n
		if d[i] > 1
			x = copy(z)
			for j in 1:i
				x[j] = 0.0
			end
			tmp = 0.0
			tes = 0.0
			for j in to[i]
				tes += z[j]
				tmp = max(tmp,z[j])
			end
			x[i] = (tes-tmp)/(d[i]-1)+1.0
			for j in 1:i-1
				for k in to[i-j]
					x[i-j] += (1.0+x[k])/d[i-j]
				end
			end
			minim = min(minim,x[1])
		end
	end
	println(minim)
end

main()

(declaim (inline find-argopt))
(defun find-argopt (sequence predicate &key (start 0) end (key #'identity))
  "Returns an index x at which SEQUENCE takes the minimal (or maximal, depending
on PREDICATE) value, and returns SEQUENCE[x] as the second value.

To explain the behaviour briefly, when (FUNCALL PREDICATE (AREF SEQUENCE
<index>) (AREF SEQUENCE <index of current optimum>)) holds, <index> and <index
of current optimum> are swapped."
  (declare ((or null (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) end)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start)
           (sequence sequence))
  (labels ((invalid-range-error ()
             (error "Can't find optimal value in null interval [~A, ~A) on ~A" start end sequence)))
    (etypecase sequence
      (list
       (let ((sequence (nthcdr start sequence))
             (end (or end most-positive-fixnum)))
         (when (or (null sequence)
                   (>= start end))
           (invalid-range-error))
         (let ((opt-element (car sequence))
               (opt-index start)
               (pos start))
           (dolist (x sequence)
             (when (>= pos end)
               (return-from find-argopt (values opt-index opt-element)))
             (when (funcall predicate (funcall key x) (funcall key opt-element))
               (setq opt-element x
                     opt-index pos))
             (incf pos))
           (values opt-index opt-element))))
      (vector
       (let ((end (or end (length sequence))))
         (when (or (>= start end)
                   (>= start (length sequence)))
           (invalid-range-error))
         (let ((opt-element (aref sequence start))
               (opt-index start))
           (loop for i from start below end
                 for x = (aref sequence i)
                 do (when (funcall predicate (funcall key x) (funcall key opt-element))
                      (setq opt-element x
                            opt-index i)))
           (values opt-index opt-element)))))))

;; The storage for the cache is hash-table or array. Let's see an example for
;; array:
;; (with-cache (:array (10 20 30) :initial-element -1 :element-type 'fixnum)
;;   (defun foo (a b c) ... ))
;; This form stores the value of FOO in the array created by (make-array (list
;; 10 20 30) :initial-element -1 :element-type 'fixnum). Note that
;; INITIAL-ELEMENT must always be given here as it is used as the flag for `not
;; yet stored'. (Therefore INITIAL-ELEMENT should be a value FOO never takes.)
;;
;; If you want to ignore some arguments, you can put `*' in dimensions:
;; (with-cache (:array (10 10 * 10) :initial-element -1)
;;   (defun foo (a b c d) ...)) ; then C is ignored when querying or storing cache
;;
;; Available definition forms in WITH-CACHE are DEFUN, LABELS, FLET, and
;; SB-INT:NAMED-LET.
;;
;; You can trace the memoized function by :TRACE option:
;; (with-cache (:array (10 10) :initial-element -1 :trace t)
;;   (defun foo (x y) ...))
;; Then FOO is traced as with CL:TRACE.
;;

;; TODO & NOTE: Currently a memoized function is not enclosed with a block of
;; the function name.

;; FIXME: *RECURSION-DEPTH* should be included within the macro.
(declaim (type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) *recursion-depth*))
(defparameter *recursion-depth* 0)

(eval-when (:compile-toplevel :load-toplevel :execute)
  (defun %enclose-with-trace (fname args form)

         (format t "~&~A~A: (~A ~{~A~^ ~}) =>"
                 (make-string *recursion-depth*
                              :element-type 'base-char
                              :initial-element #\ )
                 *recursion-depth*
                 ',fname
                 (list ,@args))
         (let ((,value (let ((*recursion-depth* (1+ *recursion-depth*)))
                         ,form)))
           (format t "~&~A~A: (~A ~{~A~^ ~}) => ~A"
                   (make-string *recursion-depth*
                                :element-type 'base-char
                                :initial-element #\ )
                   *recursion-depth*
                   ',fname
                   (list ,@args)
                   ,value)
           ,value))))

  (defun %extract-declarations (body)
    (remove-if-not (lambda (form) (and (consp form) (eql 'declare (car form))))
                   body))

  (defun %parse-cache-form (cache-specifier)
    (let ((cache-type (car cache-specifier))
          (cache-attribs (cdr cache-specifier)))
      (assert (member cache-type '(:hash-table :array)))
      (let* ((dims-with-* (when (eql cache-type :array) (first cache-attribs)))
             (dims (remove '* dims-with-*))
             (rank (length dims))
             (rest-attribs (ecase cache-type
                             (:hash-table cache-attribs)
                             (:array (cdr cache-attribs))))
             (key (prog1 (getf rest-attribs :key) (remf rest-attribs :key)))
             (trace-p (prog1 (getf rest-attribs :trace) (remf rest-attribs :trace)))
             (cache-form (case cache-type
                           (:hash-table `(make-hash-table ,@rest-attribs))
                           (:array `(make-array (list ,@dims) ,@rest-attribs))))
             (initial-element (when (eql cache-type :array)
                                (assert (member :initial-element rest-attribs))
                                (getf rest-attribs :initial-element))))
        (let ((cache (gensym "CACHE"))
              (value (gensym))
	      (present-p (gensym))
              (name-alias (gensym))
	      (args-lst (gensym))
              (indices (loop repeat rank collect (gensym))))
          (labels
              ((make-cache-querier (cache-type name args)
                 (let ((res (case cache-type
                              (:hash-table
                               `(let ((,args-lst (funcall ,(or key #'list) ,@args)))
                                  (multiple-value-bind (,value ,present-p)
                                      (gethash ,args-lst ,cache)
                                    (if ,present-p
                                        ,value
                                        (setf (gethash ,args-lst ,cache)
                                              (,name-alias ,@args))))))
                              (:array
                               (let ((memoized-args (loop for dimension in dims-with-*
                                                          for arg in args
                                                          unless (eql dimension '*)
                                                          collect arg)))
                                 (if key
                                     `(multiple-value-bind ,indices
                                          (funcall ,key ,@memoized-args)
                                        (let ((,value (aref ,cache ,@indices)))
                                          (if (eql ,initial-element ,value)
                                              (setf (aref ,cache ,@indices)
                                                    (,name-alias ,@args))
                                              ,value)))
                                     `(let ((,value (aref ,cache ,@memoized-args)))
                                        (if (eql ,initial-element ,value)
                                            (setf (aref ,cache ,@memoized-args)
                                                  (,name-alias ,@args))
                                            ,value))))))))
                   (if trace-p
                       (%enclose-with-trace name args res)
                       res)))
               (make-reset-form (cache-type)
                 (case cache-type
                   (:hash-table `(setf ,cache (make-hash-table ,@rest-attribs)))
                   (:array `(prog1 nil
                              (fill (array-storage-vector ,cache) ,initial-element)))))
               (make-reset-name (name)
                 (intern (format nil "RESET-~A" (symbol-name name)))))
            (values cache cache-form cache-type name-alias
                    #'make-reset-name
                    #'make-reset-form
                    #'make-cache-querier)))))))

(defmacro with-cache ((cache-type &rest cache-attribs) def-form)
  "CACHE-TYPE := :HASH-TABLE | :ARRAY.
DEF-FORM := definition form with DEFUN, LABELS, FLET, or SB-INT:NAMED-LET."
  (multiple-value-bind (cache-symbol cache-form cache-type name-alias
                        make-reset-name make-reset-form
                        make-cache-querier)
      (%parse-cache-form (cons cache-type cache-attribs))
    (ecase (car def-form)
      ((defun)
       (destructuring-bind (_ name args &body body) def-form
         (declare (ignore _))
         `(let ((,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
            (defun ,(funcall make-reset-name name) ()
              ,(funcall make-reset-form cache-type))
            (defun ,name ,args
              ,@(%extract-declarations body)
              (labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type name args))))))
      ((labels flet)
       (destructuring-bind (_ definitions &body labels-body) def-form
         (declare (ignore _))
         (destructuring-bind (name args &body body) (car definitions)
           `(let ((,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
              (,(car def-form)
               ((,(funcall make-reset-name name) ()
                 ,(funcall make-reset-form cache-type))
                (,name ,args
                       ,@(%extract-declarations body)
                       (labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                         (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                         ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type name args)))
                ,@(cdr definitions))
               (declare (ignorable #',(funcall make-reset-name name)))
               ,@labels-body)))))
      ((nlet #+sbcl sb-int:named-let)
       (destructuring-bind (_ name bindings &body body) def-form
         (declare (ignore _))
         `(let ((,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
            (,(car def-form) ,name ,bindings
             ,@(%extract-declarations body)
             ,(let ((args (mapcar (lambda (x) (if (atom x) x (car x))) bindings)))
                `(labels ((,name-alias ,args ,@body))
                   (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                   ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type name args))))))))))

(defmacro with-caches (cache-specs def-form)
  "DEF-FORM := definition form by LABELS or FLET.

 (with-caches (cache-spec1 cache-spec2)
   (labels ((f (x) ...) (g (y) ...))))
is equivalent to the line up of
 (with-cache cache-spec1 (labels ((f (x) ...))))
and
 (with-cache cache-spec2 (labels ((g (y) ...))))

This macro will be useful to do mutual recursion between memoized local
functions."
  (assert (member (car def-form) '(labels flet)))
  (let (cache-symbol-list cache-form-list cache-type-list name-alias-list make-reset-name-list make-reset-form-list make-cache-querier-list)
    (dolist (cache-spec (reverse cache-specs))
      (multiple-value-bind (cache-symbol cache-form cache-type name-alias
                            make-reset-name make-reset-form make-cache-querier)
          (%parse-cache-form cache-spec)
        (push cache-symbol cache-symbol-list)
        (push cache-form cache-form-list)
        (push cache-type cache-type-list)
        (push name-alias name-alias-list)
        (push make-reset-name make-reset-name-list)
        (push make-reset-form make-reset-form-list)
        (push make-cache-querier make-cache-querier-list)))
    (labels ((def-name (def) (first def))
             (def-args (def) (second def))
             (def-body (def) (cddr def)))
      (destructuring-bind (_ definitions &body labels-body) def-form
        (declare (ignore _))
        `(let ,(loop for cache-symbol in cache-symbol-list
                     for cache-form in cache-form-list
                     collect `(,cache-symbol ,cache-form))
           (,(car def-form)
            (,@(loop for def in definitions
                     for cache-type in cache-type-list
                     for make-reset-name in make-reset-name-list
                     for make-reset-form in make-reset-form-list
                     collect `(,(funcall make-reset-name (def-name def)) ()
                               ,(funcall make-reset-form cache-type)))
             ,@(loop for def in definitions
                     for cache-type in cache-type-list
                     for name-alias in name-alias-list
                     for make-cache-querier in make-cache-querier-list
                     collect `(,(def-name def) ,(def-args def)
                               ,@(%extract-declarations (def-body def))
                               (labels ((,name-alias ,(def-args def) ,@(def-body def)))
                                 (declare (inline ,name-alias))
                                 ,(funcall make-cache-querier cache-type (def-name def) (def-args def))))))
            (declare (ignorable ,@(loop for def in definitions
                                        for make-reset-name in make-reset-name-list
                                        collect `#',(funcall make-reset-name
                                                             (def-name def)))))
            ,@labels-body))))))

;; Reference: http://drken1215.hatenablog.com/entry/2019/03/20/202800
(defun echelon! (matrix &optional extended)
  "Returns the row echelon form of MATRIX by gaussian elimination and returns
the rank as the second value.

This function destructively modifies MATRIX."
  (labels ((%zerop (x)
             (< (abs x) 1d-9)))
    (destructuring-bind (m n) (array-dimensions matrix)
      (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) m n))
      (let ((rank 0))
        (dotimes (target-col (if extended (- n 1) n))
          (let ((pivot-row (do ((i rank (+ 1 i)))
                               ((= i m) -1)
                             (unless (%zerop (aref matrix i target-col))
                               (return i)))))
            (when (>= pivot-row 0)
              ;; swap rows
              (loop for j from target-col below n
                    do (rotatef (aref matrix rank j) (aref matrix pivot-row j)))
              (let ((inv (/ (aref matrix rank target-col))))
                (dotimes (j n)
                  (setf (aref matrix rank j)
                        (* inv (aref matrix rank j))))
                (dotimes (i m)
                  (unless (or (= i rank) (%zerop (aref matrix i target-col)))
                    (let ((factor (aref matrix i target-col)))
                      (loop for j from target-col below n
                            do (setf (aref matrix i j)
                                     (- (aref matrix i j)
                                        (* (aref matrix rank j) factor))))))))
              (incf rank))))
        (values matrix rank)))))

(defun solve-linear-system (matrix vector)
  "Solves Ax ≡ b and returns a root vector if it exists. Otherwise it returns
NIL. In addition, this function returns the rank of A as the second value."
  (destructuring-bind (m n) (array-dimensions matrix)
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) m n))
    (assert (= n (length vector)))
    (let ((extended (make-array (list m (+ n 1)) :element-type (array-element-type matrix))))
      (labels ((%zerop (x)
                 (< (abs x) 1d-9)))
        (dotimes (i m)
          (dotimes (j n) (setf (aref extended i j) (aref matrix i j)))
          (setf (aref extended i n) (aref vector i)))
        (let ((rank (nth-value 1 (echelon! extended t))))
          (if (loop for i from rank below m
                    always (%zerop (aref extended i n)))
              (let ((result (make-array m
                                        :element-type (array-element-type matrix)
                                        :initial-element 0)))
                (dotimes (i rank)
                  (setf (aref result i) (aref extended i n)))
                (values result rank))
              (values nil rank)))))))

         (revgraph (make-array n :element-type 'list :initial-element nil))
         (out-degrees (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (in-degrees (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (ss (make-array m :element-type 'uint31))
         (ts (make-array m :element-type 'uint31)))
    (dotimes (i m)
      (let ((src (- (read-fixnum) 1))
            (dest (- (read-fixnum) 1)))
        (push dest (aref graph src))
        (push src (aref revgraph dest))
        (incf (aref out-degrees src))
        (incf (aref in-degrees dest))
        (setf (aref ss i) src)
        (setf (aref ts i) dest)))
    #>out-degrees
    (with-cache (:array (601 (+ m 1)) :element-type 'double-float :initial-element most-negative-double-float)
      (labels ((calc (v seg-id)

                     0d0
                     (let ((exists nil)
                           (value 0d0)
                           (src (if (= seg-id m) -1 (aref ss seg-id)))
                           (dest (if (= seg-id m) -1 (aref ts seg-id))))
                       (dolist (prev (aref revgraph v))
                         (unless (and (= prev src) (= dest v))
                           (let ((delta (calc prev seg-id)))
                             (unless (= delta most-positive-double-float)
                               (setq exists t)
                               (incf value (/ delta (aref out-degrees prev)))))))
                       (if exists
                           (+ value 1d0)

        (let ((res (calc (- n 1) m)))
          (loop for seg-id from 0 below m
                do (let ((src (aref ss seg-id))
                         (dest  (aref ts seg-id)))
                     (decf (aref out-degrees src))
                     #>out-degrees
                     (let ((value #>(calc (- n 1) seg-id)))
                       (unless (= most-positive-double-float value)
                         (setq res (min res value))))
                     (incf (aref out-degrees src))))
          (println res))))))

(declaim (inline find-argopt))
(defun find-argopt (sequence predicate &key (start 0) end (key #'identity))
  "Returns an index x at which SEQUENCE takes the minimal (or maximal, depending
on PREDICATE) value, and returns SEQUENCE[x] as the second value.

To explain the behaviour briefly, when (FUNCALL PREDICATE (AREF SEQUENCE
<index>) (AREF SEQUENCE <index of current optimum>)) holds, <index> and <index
of current optimum> are swapped."
  (declare ((or null (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) end)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start)
           (sequence sequence))
  (labels ((invalid-range-error ()
             (error "Can't find optimal value in null interval [~A, ~A) on ~A" start end sequence)))
    (etypecase sequence
      (list
       (let ((sequence (nthcdr start sequence))
             (end (or end most-positive-fixnum)))
         (when (or (null sequence)
                   (>= start end))
           (invalid-range-error))
         (let ((opt-element (car sequence))
               (opt-index start)
               (pos start))
           (dolist (x sequence)
             (when (>= pos end)
               (return-from find-argopt (values opt-index opt-element)))
             (when (funcall predicate (funcall key x) (funcall key opt-element))
               (setq opt-element x
                     opt-index pos))
             (incf pos))
           (values opt-index opt-element))))
      (vector
       (let ((end (or end (length sequence))))
         (when (or (>= start end)
                   (>= start (length sequence)))
           (invalid-range-error))
         (let ((opt-element (aref sequence start))
               (opt-index start))
           (loop for i from start below end
                 for x = (aref sequence i)
                 do (when (funcall predicate (funcall key x) (funcall key opt-element))
                      (setq opt-element x
                            opt-index i)))
           (values opt-index opt-element)))))))

(declaim (inline find-argopt))
(defun find-argopt (sequence predicate &key (start 0) end (key #'identity))
  "Returns an index x at which SEQUENCE takes the minimal (or maximal, depending
on PREDICATE) value, and returns SEQUENCE[x] as the second value.

To explain the behaviour briefly, when (FUNCALL PREDICATE (AREF SEQUENCE
<index>) (AREF SEQUENCE <index of current optimum>)) holds, <index> and <index
of current optimum> are swapped."
  (declare ((or null (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) end)
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start)
           (sequence sequence))
  (labels ((invalid-range-error ()
             (error "Can't find optimal value in null interval [~A, ~A) on ~A" start end sequence)))
    (etypecase sequence
      (list
       (let ((sequence (nthcdr start sequence))
             (end (or end most-positive-fixnum)))
         (when (or (null sequence)
                   (>= start end))
           (invalid-range-error))
         (let ((opt-element (car sequence))
               (opt-index start)
               (pos start))
           (dolist (x sequence)
             (when (>= pos end)
               (return-from find-argopt (values opt-index opt-element)))
             (when (funcall predicate (funcall key x) (funcall key opt-element))
               (setq opt-element x
                     opt-index pos))
             (incf pos))
           (values opt-index opt-element))))
      (vector
       (let ((end (or end (length sequence))))
         (when (or (>= start end)
                   (>= start (length sequence)))
           (invalid-range-error))
         (let ((opt-element (aref sequence start))
               (opt-index start))
           (loop for i from start below end
                 for x = (aref sequence i)
                 do (when (funcall predicate (funcall key x) (funcall key opt-element))
                      (setq opt-element x
                            opt-index i)))
           (values opt-index opt-element)))))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values fixnum &optional)) read-fixnum))
(defun read-fixnum (&optional (in *standard-input*))
  (declare #.OPT)
  (macrolet ((%read-byte ()
               `(the (unsigned-byte 8)
                     #+swank (char-code (read-char in nil #\Nul))
                     #-swank (sb-impl::ansi-stream-read-byte in nil #.(char-code #\Nul) nil))))
    (let* ((minus nil)
           (result (loop (let ((byte (%read-byte)))
                           (cond ((<= 48 byte 57)
                                  (return (- byte 48)))
                                 ((zerop byte) ; #\Nul
                                  (error "Read EOF or #\Nul."))
                                 ((= byte #.(char-code #\-))
                                  (setf minus t)))))))
      (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) result))
      (loop
        (let* ((byte (%read-byte)))
          (if (<= 48 byte 57)
              (setq result (+ (- byte 48)
                              (* 10 (the (integer 0 #.(floor most-positive-fixnum 10)) result))))
              (return (if minus (- result) result))))))))

let scan_int () = Scanf.scanf " %d" (fun x -> x)
let print_float n = Printf.printf "%.12f\n" n

(* 辺の入力 *)
let input_edge edges m =
  for i = 0 to m-1 do
    let s = scan_int() and t = scan_int() in
    edges.(s-1) <- (t-1) :: edges.(s-1) 
  done

(* 頂点vからの期待値の計算 *)
let calc_expected_value n edges =
  let expected = Array.make n 0.0 in
  let prop expect p u v = expect.(u) <- expect.(u) +. (expect.(v) +. 1.0) *. p in
  let rec rev_calc curr edges ret =
    if curr < 0 then ret
    else
      let p = 1.0 /. (float (List.length edges.(curr))) in
      let _ = List.iter (prop ret p curr) edges.(curr) in
      rev_calc (curr-1) edges ret in
  rev_calc (n-1) edges expected

(* 頂点vを通る確率の計算 *)
let calc_probability n edges =
  let probability = Array.make n 0.0 in
  let _ = probability.(0) <- 1.0 in
  let prop prob p u v = prob.(v) <- prob.(v) +. prob.(u) *. p in
  let rec calc curr edges ret =
    if curr = n then ret
    else
      let p = 1.0 /. (float (List.length edges.(curr))) in
      let _ = List.iter (prop ret p curr) edges.(curr) in
      calc (curr+1) edges ret in
  calc 0 edges probability


let solve n edges expected probability =
  let ans = ref expected.(0) in
  let p = expected.(0) in
  let _ =
    for u = 0 to n-1 do
      let l = List.length edges.(u) in
      if l <= 1 then ()
      else
        let add_prob = 1.0 /. (float (l-1)) -. 1.0 /. (float l) in
        let fold_func p v = p +. add_prob *. expected.(v) *. probability.(u) in
        let ref_value = List.fold_left fold_func p edges.(u) in
        let sub_prob = 1.0 /. (float (l-1)) in
        let calc_func v =
          let result = ref_value -. sub_prob *. expected.(v) *. probability.(u) in
          ans := min !ans result in
        List.iter calc_func edges.(u)
    done in
  print_float !ans


let () =
  let n = scan_int() and m = scan_int() in
  let edges = Array.make n [] in
  let _ = input_edge edges m in
  let expected = calc_expected_value n edges in
  let probability = calc_probability n edges in
  solve n edges expected probability

def gauss_jordan(A, is_extended = True):
    """掃き出し法でジョルダン標準形を求める
    計算量O(...)
    """
    cnt_col = len(A[0])
    cnt_row = len(A)
    
    rank = 0
    for col in range(cnt_col):
        #  拡大係数行列の場合は最後の行は掃き出ししない
        if is_extended and col == cnt_col - 1:
            break

        # ピボットを探す
        pivot = -1
        eps = 10**(-10)
        for row in range(rank, cnt_row):
            if abs(A[row][col]) > eps:
                eps = abs(A[row][col])
                pivot = row

        #  ピボットがない場合は次の列に
        if pivot == -1:
            continue

        # 行をスワップする
        A[pivot], A[rank] = A[rank], A[pivot]

        # ピボットの値を1にする
        fac = A[rank][col]
        for col2 in range(cnt_col):
            A[rank][col2] = A[rank][col2] / fac


        # ピボットのある列の値がすべて0になるように掃き出す
        for row in range(cnt_row):
            if row != rank and A[row][col] > 0.001:
                fac = A[row][col]
                for col2 in range(cnt_col):
                    A[row][col2] -= A[rank][col2] * fac
        rank += 1
    if A[-1][-2] == 0:
        return float("inf")
    return A[-1][-1]

def solve(n, m, s, t):
    edges = [[] for i in range(n)]
    for i in range(m):
        u, v = s[i], t[i]
        edges[u-1].append(v-1)
    p = [0] * n
    p[0] = 1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in edges[i]:
            p[j] += p[i] / len(edges[i])
    E = [0] * n
    for i in range(n-2, -1, -1):
        v = [E[j] for j in edges[i]]
        E[i] = 1 + sum(v) / len(v)
    res = E[0]
    for i in range(n):
        deg = len(edges[i])
        if deg <= 1:
            continue
        k = max((E[j], j) for j in edges[i])[1]
        v = [E[j] for j in edges[i] if j != k]
        res = min(res, E[0] + p[i] * (sum(v) / (deg-1) - E[k]) / deg)
    return res

def recalculate_dist(node, E_dist_to_goal):
    recal_E_dist = [0]*(node+1)
    routes = edges_from[node]
    num_of_routes = len(routes)
    if num_of_routes == 1:
        return False

    heaviest_route = max(E_dist_to_goal[next_node]+1 for next_node in routes)
    new_dist = E_dist_to_goal[node] - heaviest_route/num_of_routes
    new_dist *= num_of_routes / (num_of_routes - 1)
    recal_E_dist[node] = new_dist

    for v in range(node-1, -1, -1):
        routes = edges_from[v]
        num_of_routes = len(routes)
        for nv in routes:
            if nv > node:
                dist = E_dist_to_goal[nv] + 1
            else:
                dist = recal_E_dist[nv] + 1
            recal_E_dist[v] += dist
        recal_E_dist[v] /= num_of_routes
    return recal_E_dist[0]


ans = [E_dist_to_goal[0]]

    for u in range(n):

    new_dist *= num_of_routes / (num_of_routes - 1)

        wf[i] = dict()
        next_id[i] = dict()

            for j in range(V):
                if wf[i][j] > wf[i][k] + wf[k][j]:
                    wf[i][j] = wf[i][k] + wf[k][j]
                    next_id[i][j] = next_id[i][k]

    stuck_order = set()

    command = [None] * T
    heading = 0 #次に向かう地点
    dist_left = 0 #次に向かう地点までの残り距離
    final_dist = 0
    stuck_cost = [[0, 0] for _ in range(V)] 
    cost = [[0, 0] for _ in range(V)] 
    driver_hold = 0
    store_hold = 0
    total_order = [0] * (T + 1)
    dt = [0] * T
    Tpeak = (0 + 0.95 * T) / 2
    peak_passed = False

        N = int(input()) #注文の発生
        total_order[t+1] = total_order[t] + N

        if N == 1:

            stuck_cost[dst - 1][0] += (Tpeak - t if not peak_passed else t)
            stuck_cost[dst - 1][1] += 1
            store_hold += 1

            dist_left -= 1

                else:

                    for key in order:

        if e[cur] != -1:

        res = 0
        cnt = 0
        for to in g[cur]:

            cnt += 1
        # 0のとき→end

        e[cur] = res
        return e[cur]

            cnt += 1
        if cnt:

        ee[cur] = res
        return ee[cur]

    # 何もしなかった時が最小値の候補の内最大

    use = [[-1, -1] for i in range(n)]

from copy import copy

def solve(n, m, s, t):
    E = {}
    for i in range(m):
        u, v = s[i], t[i]
        if not u in E:
            E[u] = []
        E[u].append(v)
    dp = [INF] * (n+1)
    dp[n] = 0
    for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
        v = [dp[j] for j in E[i]]
        dp[i] = 1 + sum(v) / len(v)
    dp2 = copy(dp)
    res = dp[1]
    for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
        if len(E[i]) == 1:
            continue
        v = [dp[e] for e in E[i]]
        dp2[i] = 1 + (sum(v) - max(v)) / (len(v) - 1)
        for j in range(i-1, 0, -1):
            v = [dp2[k] for k in E[j]]
            dp2[j] = 1 + sum(v) / len(v)
        res = min(res, dp2[1])
        dp2[:i+1] = copy(dp[:i+1])
    return res

def solve_f(n, g):
    e_base = [0.0] * (n + 1)
    p_base = [0.0] * (n + 1)

    # e_base
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        e_base[i] = sum([e_base[j] for j in g[i]]) / len(g[i]) + 1.0

    # p_base
    p_base[1] = 1.0
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in g[i]:
            p_base[j] += p_base[i] / len(g[i])

    # print(p_base, e_base)

    # find maximal gap
    gap = 0.0
    for i in range(1, n):
        if len(g[i]) == 1:
            continue
        total = sum([e_base[j] + 1 for j in g[i]])
        maxim = max([e_base[j] + 1 for j in g[i]])
        gap_i = (total / len(g[i]) - (total - maxim) / (len(g[i]) - 1)) * p_base[i]
        gap = max(gap_i, gap)

    return e_base[1] - gap

def gauss_jordan(A, is_extended = True):
    """掃き出し法でジョルダン標準形を求める
    計算量O(...)
    """
    cnt_col = len(A[0])
    cnt_row = len(A)
    
    rank = 0
    for col in range(cnt_col):
        #  拡大係数行列の場合は最後の行は掃き出ししない
        if is_extended and col == cnt_col - 1:
            break

        # ピボットを探す
        pivot = -1
        eps = 10**(-10)
        for row in range(rank, cnt_row):
            if abs(A[row][col]) > eps:
                eps = abs(A[row][col])
                pivot = row

        #  ピボットがない場合は次の列に
        if pivot == -1:
            continue

        # 行をスワップする
        A[pivot], A[rank] = A[rank], A[pivot]

        # ピボットの値を1にする
        fac = A[rank][col]
        for col2 in range(cnt_col):
            A[rank][col2] = A[rank][col2] / fac


        # ピボットのある列の値がすべて0になるように掃き出す
        for row in range(cnt_row):
            if row != rank and A[row][col] > 0.001:
                fac = A[row][col]
                for col2 in range(cnt_col):
                    A[row][col2] -= A[rank][col2] * fac
        rank += 1

    return A[-1][-1]

from collections import defaultdict


def main():
    N, M = list(map(int, input().split()))
    adj_from = defaultdict(list)
    adj_to = defaultdict(list)
    for _ in range(M):
        s, t = list(map(lambda x: int(x) - 1, input().split()))
        adj_from[t].append(s)
        adj_to[s].append(t)
    # prob[s][t]: 邪魔がない場合に枝s->tを通る確率
    prob = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    for t in adj_to[0]:
        prob[0][t] = 1 / len(adj_to[0])
    for s in range(1, N - 1):
        # node 's' に入ってくる確率を均等に分配
        prob_sum = sum([prob[n][s] for n in adj_from[s]])
        for t in adj_to[s]:
            prob[s][t] += prob_sum / len(adj_to[s])
    # expect[s][t]: 邪魔がなく、かつ枝s->tからカウントを始めた場合に通る枝本数の期待値
    expect = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    for s in adj_from[N - 1]:
        expect[s][N - 1] = 1
    for t in range(N - 2, 0, -1):
        # node 't' から出ていく時の本数を、node 't' に入ってくるところに反映
        e = sum([expect[t][n] for n in adj_to[t]]) / len(adj_to[t])
        for s in adj_from[t]:
            expect[s][t] += e + 1
    # 邪魔なしの場合の枝本数の期待値
    expect_all = sum([p * e for p, e in zip(prob[0], expect[0])])
    # 各edgeをふさいだ場合の枝本数の変化量の最小値を求める
    diff_min = 0  # ふさげない場合 / ふさぐと不利になる場合はふさがないので変化量0
    for s in range(N - 1):
        if len(adj_to[s]) <= 1:
            continue
        s_prob = 1 if s == 0 else sum([prob[n][s] for n in adj_from[s]])
        # expect[s][t] が最も大きいtを選んでふさぐのが良い
        expect_max, target = 0, None
        for t in adj_to[s]:
            if expect[s][t] > expect_max:
                expect_max = expect[s][t]
                target = t
        # 枝s->targetをふさいだ時の枝の期待値の変化量
        d = - prob[s][target] * expect[s][target]
        for t in adj_to[s]:
            if t == target:
                continue
            d += ((s_prob / (len(adj_to[s]) - 1)) - prob[s][t]) * expect[s][t]
        diff_min = min(diff_min, d)
    # 答え
    print(expect_all + diff_min)

def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())

    atode = []
    for i in range(m):

        g[s-1].append(t-1)
        deg2[s-1] += 1
        atode.append((s-1,t-1))

    ee = [-1]*n
    def rec2(cur, s,t):
        if ee[cur] != -1:
            return ee[cur]
        res = 0
        cnt = 0
        for to in g[cur]:
            if cur==s and to ==t:
                continue
            res += rec2(to,s,t)+1
            cnt += 1
        if cnt:
            res /= cnt
        ee[cur] = res
        return ee[cur]

    rec2(0,-1,-1)
    ret = ee[0]

    use = [[-1, -1] for i in range(n)]
    for s,t in atode:
        if deg2[s] < 2:
            continue
        if use[s][1] < ee[t]:
            use[s][0] = t
            use[s][1] = ee[t]

    for s, (t,cost) in enumerate(use):
        if s == -1:
            continue
        ee = [-1]*n
        rec2(0,s,t)
        ret = min(ret, ee[0])
    print(ret)

from copy import copy
INF = 10**9
def solve(n, m, s, t):
    E = [[] for i in range(n+1)]
    for i in range(m):
        u, v = s[i], t[i]
        E[u].append(v)
    dp = [INF] * (n+1)
    dp[n] = 0
    for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
        v = [dp[j] for j in E[i]]
        dp[i] = 1 + sum(v) / len(v)
    dp2 = copy(dp)
    res = dp[1]
    for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
        if len(E[i]) == 1:
            continue
        v = [dp[e] for e in E[i]]
        dp2[i] = 1 + (sum(v) - max(v)) / (len(v) - 1)
        for j in range(i-1, 0, -1):
            v = [dp2[k] for k in E[j]]
            dp2[j] = 1 + sum(v) / len(v)
        res = min(res, dp2[1])
        dp2[:i+1] = copy(dp[:i+1])
    return res
